standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaf condition on X: two sections agreeing on every member of an open covering are equal
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the uniqueness step concluding s = s' from the covering by the neighbourhoods V^x.

core_obligations: Suppose s, s' in F(U) have the same germ in every stalk F_x for x in U (proof lines 1175-1177). By the description of the stalk map this means that for each x there is an open neighbourhood V^x of x in U with s|_{V^x} = s'|_{V^x} (proof lines 1176-1178). The V^x cover U, so s and s' agree on the members of an open covering of U; by the uniqueness part of the sheaf condition s = s', proving injectivity (proof lines 1178-1181).
proof_roadmap: Unpack equality of germs into agreements on neighbourhoods V^x (proof lines 1175-1178).
Cover U by the V^x and conclude by sheaf uniqueness (proof lines 1178-1181).
